heading: Repealed. Aug. 26, 1954, ch. 937, title V, § 542(a)(6), 68 Stat. 861

notes.text: Sections, act June 5, 1950, ch. 220, title III, §§ 302–304, 64 Stat. 203, related to contributions to United Nations for assistance; authorization of appropriations and advances by R.F.C.; and nature of assistance. See section 2221 of this title.
